page.text:
The *image* (or range) $\operatorname{im}(T) = \{T(v) : v \in V\}$ is the
subspace of $W$ consisting of all output vectors attained by $T$. The
dimension of the image is called the *rank* of $T$,
$\operatorname{rank}(T) = \dim(\operatorname{im} T)$, while the dimension
of the kernel is the *nullity*, $\operatorname{null}(T) = \dim(\ker T)$.
